mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.promotion_id, c.range_type, c.coupon_amount, c.coupon_threshold, c.stock, c.remain_stock, c.per_limit, p.promotion_name, p.promotion_type, p.promotion_budget, p.promotion_desc, p.start_time, p.end_time FROM coupon_member cm INNER JOIN coupon c ON cm.coupon_id = c.id INNER JOIN promotion p ON c.promotion_id = p.id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.`status` = 1 AND cm.expire_time > NOW() AND c.is_deleted = 0
